# ssp_alarm (Data Source)

Reads a single alarm instance by ID.

Corresponds to `GET /ssp/alarms/{id}`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the alarm instance.

### Read-Only

- `definition_id` (String) ID of this alarm's definition.
- `description` (String) Full description of this alarm instance.
- `event_type` (String) Event type that triggered this alarm instance.
- `feature_name` (String) Feature this alarm instance is associated with.
- `kb_article` (String) Link to a Knowledge Base article for this alarm.
- `node_id` (String) UUID of the node that reported the value.
- `object_id` (String) Sub-object ID within the resource, if any.
- `recommended_action` (String) Guidance on how to address this alarm instance.
- `resource_id` (String) Identifier of the resource this alarm was raised for.
- `severity` (String) Severity level of this alarm instance.
- `state` (String) Current state of the alarm instance.
- `summary` (String) Brief overview of this alarm instance.
- `suppress_duration` (Number) Hours the alarm is suppressed for, if `state` is `SUPPRESSED`.
- `value` (String) Current reported value associated with the alarm.
